financial_unit: INR crore, except per-share INR and shares crore
scope: Consolidated. Compact cash-ownership and funded recovery sensitivity, not a full independent leadership/customer diligence or calibrated forecast.

capital.explanation: September original shareholding statement confirms 26,325,306 subscribed paid-up shares, including 114,187 employee-trust shares. Use the full count rather than a lower EPS denominator. Annual report shows FY25 buyback extinguished 448,018 shares, and current financial statements keep paid-up capital unchanged. H1 trust purchased INR8.46cr of existing shares. New awards are funded by a recurring cash reserve in the model, with no additional annual dilution assumed. Do not also add SBC as a second expense.

balance_20260930.treasury_reconciliation: Issuer CFO reports INR942.1cr cash and cash equivalents, a broad treasury metric. Signed balance sheet five-line total is INR964.23cr. INR22.13cr difference is excluded rather than guessed as distributable. Annual report describes long-term bank deposits and bond/debt-fund investments, with strategic equity and security deposits outside the ordinary cash pool. Exact September composition is not independently disclosed in these interim notes.
balance_20260930.unclaimed_and_lien_proxy_note: FY26 cash-current-account lien INR0.34cr + term-deposit lien INR0.31cr + long-term-deposit lien INR0.06cr + unclaimed dividend INR0.28cr. September breakdown not disclosed, so retain a dated proxy plus scenario haircut.
balance_20260930.working_capital_note: Contract income is already in other current assets, and advance billing/deferred revenue is already in other current liabilities. Zero explicit contract/deferred fields prevent double counting. This simplified working-capital bridge excludes separate financial-asset receivables and is a sensitivity, not a claimed exact CFO reproduction.

model_conventions.terminal_multiple_basis: Year-five funded operating cash after cash tax, all capex, leases, explicit cash purchase budget for employee share awards, operating working capital and operating liquidity growth. Treasury income is separate.
model_conventions.treasury: INR942.1cr is an issuer treasury metric corroborated in scale against the signed balance sheet, not cash equivalents of INR47.1cr and not immediately distributable. Exclude all provisions, dated lien/unclaimed balances, investment haircut and liquidity buffer. Negative operating working capital includes customer prepayments, and its transition is explicitly funded. No special dividend, buyback, liquidation floor or forced cash release is assumed.
model_conventions.sbc: Historical cash EBIT adds back H1 SBC once. Future share-award cash budget is deducted once. The full paid-up share count includes shares held by the employee trust. No additional dilution is imposed on top of cash-funded share awards.
model_conventions.leases: All D&A added back, all cash lease principal and interest deducted. Opening lease liability not subtracted a second time.
model_conventions.rd: Product development remains inside operating margin. All tangible and intangible capex is deducted. No large capitalized-software addback.
model_conventions.returns: Five normalized forward annual periods. Annual dividend assumption is a payout of available operating and treasury cash. Reported INR12.50 dividend is not assumed guaranteed. IRR includes modeled dividends, no fees or personal tax.
model_conventions.funding: Negative funded operating cash consumes available treasury. Negative treasury is recorded as external funding needed. No hidden borrowing.

downside.rationale: No growth, weak margins, prepayment funding disappears, incremental bad debt or investment cash loss and larger treasury haircut. Does not treat the current negative CFO as permanent every year.

base.rationale: Revenue grows near the latest Q2 rate, above current H1 growth. Cash EBIT margin gradually recovers toward, but below, FY26 ex-exception/other-income margin. This partial operating recovery is an assumption requiring collection and expense evidence, not an observed turnaround.

upside.rationale: Product upgrades and bank wins convert into double-digit revenue growth, higher recurring operating margins and customer-funded working capital. This is favorable execution evidence still to be earned.
